finding.statement: VoiceOutcome.__post_init__ validates outcome_kind only by membership in _ALLOWED_OUTCOMES. Unlike _identifier and _sha256 trust-boundary helpers, it does not require type(outcome_kind) is str. A str subclass equal to an admitted value therefore crosses the boundary even though it is not an exact concrete string scalar.
finding.counterexample: class StringSubclass(str): pass; value = StringSubclass('RETURNED'); type(value) is str is False while value in frozenset(('RETURNED', ...)) is True
finding.expected_fail_closed_behavior: Reject non-exact string scalar subclasses before admitted-value membership is evaluated.
finding.minimal_repair: Require type(outcome_kind) is str and outcome_kind in _ALLOWED_OUTCOMES; add a regression test that StringSubclass(OUTCOME_RETURNED) raises VoiceContractError.
finding.scope: repository source-boundary review only; no audio/provider/VPS/runtime/effect/completion/GRID/GWT/J-Space/training/whole-system credit
